[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (operations: List Int) (i: Nat) (balance: Int) (result: Bool) : Bool :=
  match operations with
  | [] => result
  | head :: tail =>
    let new_balance := head + balance
    if new_balance < 0 then
      true
    else
      loop tail (Nat.succ i) new_balance result
loop operations 0 0 false
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation operations
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  by_cases h_result_true: result = true
  -- Case 1: result = true
  simp [h_result_true]
  use (Nat.zero, Nat.zero, 0, false)
  simp [below_zero_condition]
  simp [Nat.zero_le_operations.length]
  simp [List.take_zero]
  simp [List.take_operations.length]
  simp [0 < 0]
  exact h_result_true
  -- Case 2: result = false
  simp [h_result_true]
  use (Nat.zero, Nat.zero, 0, true)
  simp [below_zero_condition]
  simp [Nat.zero_le_operations.length]
  simp [List.take_zero]
  simp [List.take_operations.length]
  simp [0 < 0]
  have h_result_false: result = false := by
    linarith
  simp [h_result_false]
  simp [implementation]
  simp [loop]
  simp [Nat.zero_le_operations.length]
  simp [List.take_zero]
  simp [List.take_operations.length]
  simp [0 < 0]
  have h_balance_non_negative: 0 ≤ balance := by
    linarith
  have h_new_balance_non_negative: 0 ≤ new_balance := by
    linarith
  have h_new_balance_non_negative': 0 ≤ new_balance := by
    linarith
  simp [h_new_balance_non_negative]
  simp [h_new_balance_non_negative']
  exact h_result_false
[END]
